snippet.title: Stranded Deep 2 - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Survival is just the beginning. The open-world survival crafting experience returns. Stranded in a desert wilderness, an endless river is your only lifeline. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and build a floating home to brave the treacherous waters and scorching heat. Every bend brings new danger and deeper discoveries.

*How far will you go?*
